recipes.description: Verify ticket, workflow and response state through the audited Helpdesk context.
interpretation_rules: Helpdesk and Hermes terminal state must agree.
stop_conditions: Current ticket and response state are established.
escalation_conditions: Workflow binding is absent or contradictory.
review_checks: Material status claims cite ticket_state evidence.

recipes.description: Trace a production or consumption posting from MES state to outbound SAP result.
interpretation_rules: Pending, failed and never-created are different states.
Absence from one surface does not prove causation.
stop_conditions: MES record, outbound posting and API outcome are reconciled.
escalation_conditions: Required correction is a production write or identifier remains ambiguous.

recipes.description: Determine whether a named API transaction ran and its latest recorded result.
interpretation_rules: Use the latest row per transaction and exclude test/configuration noise.
stop_conditions: Latest live API result for the requested identifier is established.
escalation_conditions: API type cannot be identified safely.
review_checks: Claims that an API ran or failed cite sap_api_result.

recipes.description: Trace campaign membership, work-order master state and SAP-side creation state.
interpretation_rules: Internal ID, WorkOrderNumber and MESWorkOrderNumber are distinct identifiers.
HeatNo may contain a comma-separated allocation.
stop_conditions: Campaign, master and external work-order identity are reconciled.
escalation_conditions: Creation logic requires mutation or product branch is not safely identifiable.
review_checks: Work-order existence and state claims cite work_order_state.

recipes.description: Trace a heat through EAF, LRF, CCM, billet and related work-order state.
interpretation_rules: Multiple rows may represent workflow stages.
Reference formulas require current-definition verification before causal use.
stop_conditions: The heat stage and disputed value are established from current rows.
escalation_conditions: Heat identity is ambiguous or correction requires a write.

recipes.description: Trace billet genealogy, count, transfer and inventory/master relationships.
interpretation_rules: Billet yard and electrical switchyard are unrelated domains.
Operator and tag-driven billet counts may differ.
stop_conditions: Heat, strand, billet and current inventory identity are reconciled.
escalation_conditions: Genealogy is absent across all canonical surfaces or repair requires mutation.
review_checks: Genealogy and count claims cite billet_genealogy.

recipes.description: Trace chemistry, spectro, quality deviation and SAP quality-decision evidence.
interpretation_rules: File, sample and result are separate stages.
Configuration thresholds are not transaction results.
stop_conditions: The failed or completed quality stage is identified.
escalation_conditions: The relevant product/quality path is ambiguous or needs configuration mutation.

recipes.description: Trace delay/OEE events, classification, equipment and aggregate projections.
interpretation_rules: Event rows and aggregate rows are not interchangeable.
Area determines the applicable shift-delay family.
stop_conditions: Event, equipment, classification and report window are reconciled.
escalation_conditions: Affected time window or equipment identity is missing.

recipes.description: Inspect the audited run, action, trace, response and escalation lifecycle.
stop_conditions: Run and Helpdesk state agree or the divergence is identified.
escalation_conditions: A lifecycle mutation is required outside reconciliation.

recipes.description: Narrow an unclassified symptom through deterministic metadata without assuming a domain.
interpretation_rules: Metadata matches are leads, not ticket facts.
stop_conditions: A supported domain and current evidence surface are identified.
escalation_conditions: No supported domain can be established within the bounded investigation.
review_checks: Do not approve causal claims supported only by metadata discovery.
